description: Health and responsibility dashboard for the Slurm Advisor Controller. All controller and watchdog metrics are scoped by the selected environment label.

panels.description: Prometheus scrape health for the nvidia-recovery-slurm-advisor service in the selected environment.
panels.title: SAC scrape health

panels.description: Completed reconciliation ticks per minute.
panels.title: Reconciliation cadence

panels.description: Percentage of completed reconciliation ticks whose overall outcome was success.
panels.title: Tick success rate

panels.description: Failed reconciliation ticks in Grafana's current rate interval.
panels.title: Failed ticks

panels.description: Completed ticks in the last two minutes. Zero while scrape health is UP means the controller loop is stalled.
panels.title: Ticks in last 2m

panels.description: 95th percentile reconciliation duration over the current rate interval.
panels.title: Tick duration p95

panels.description: Median whole-tick reconciliation duration by configured controller mode.
panels.title: Whole-tick duration p50

panels.description: Whole-tick latency distribution by configured controller mode.
panels.title: Whole-tick duration p95

panels.description: Average whole-tick duration by configured controller mode.
panels.title: Whole-tick average duration

panels.description: Median duration for each bounded reconciliation stage.
panels.title: Stage duration p50

panels.description: 95th percentile duration for each bounded reconciliation stage.
panels.title: Stage duration p95

panels.description: Average duration for each bounded reconciliation stage.
panels.title: Stage average duration

panels.description: Median duration of each individual dependency read within the job_status_polling stage, grouped by source. Concurrent reads overlap and should not be summed to estimate the stage duration; heimdall_jobs is normally emitted only during process bootstrap.
panels.title: Source read duration p50

panels.description: 90th percentile duration of each individual dependency read within the job_status_polling stage, grouped by source. Concurrent reads overlap and should not be summed to estimate the stage duration; heimdall_jobs is normally emitted only during process bootstrap.
panels.title: Source read duration p90

panels.description: Average duration of each individual dependency read within the job_status_polling stage, grouped by source. Concurrent reads overlap and should not be summed to estimate the stage duration; heimdall_jobs is normally emitted only during process bootstrap.
panels.title: Source read average duration

panels.description: Stage failures over Grafana's rate interval. Later stages are absent when an earlier stage terminates the tick.
panels.title: Stage failures

panels.description: Entries in the in-memory job-attempt cache after the latest completed tick. This cache resets when SAC restarts.
panels.title: Active job-attempt cache

panels.description: Environment-admitted active Slurm jobs in the most recent snapshot.
panels.title: Active Slurm jobs

panels.description: Advice records fetched into the most recent controller snapshot.
panels.title: Advice fetched last tick

panels.description: Advice records that entered reconciliation during the most recent tick, including skips and failed actions.
panels.title: Advice entered last tick

panels.description: Fetched advice that did not enter reconciliation. This can mean environment rejection, cancellation, or an early failure; it is not a pure backlog metric.
panels.title: Advice not entered

panels.description: Latest controller snapshot sizes. seen_store is read near the start of a tick; the active cache stat above is measured after the tick.
panels.title: Jobs in latest snapshot

panels.description: Advice item throughput from Heimdall. Durable advice is counted again on each poll and this is therefore read volume, not unique advice.
panels.title: Advice read from backend

panels.description: Logical reads from Slurm, Heimdall, and the seen store by source and outcome.
panels.title: Dependency source reads

panels.description: Heimdall job upsert attempts per minute. Error includes both request-building errors and backend call errors.
panels.title: Job status upserts per minute

panels.description: Average job upserts per completed reconciliation tick over the current rate interval. SAC does not currently expose an exact last-tick upsert gauge.
panels.title: Average job upserts per tick

panels.description: Successful scheduler actions executed for advice. This counts actions, not advice records; one advice may execute multiple actions.
panels.title: Successful advice actions

panels.description: Scheduler actions that SAC would execute in observe mode.
panels.title: Planned advice actions

panels.description: Advice records that required no action because fresh Slurm state already satisfied them.
panels.title: Advice already converged

panels.description: All advice skips by bounded reason. already_satisfied is healthy; investigate unsupported, empty, missing, future, or excessive stale advice.
panels.title: Advice skips by reason

panels.description: Failed reads from Slurm, Heimdall, or the local seen store.
panels.title: Dependency read failures

panels.description: Failed job upserts. The metric currently conflates request-building failures with backend call failures.
panels.title: Job upsert failures

panels.description: Scheduler action failures while applying advice.
panels.title: Advice action failures

panels.description: Direct failed-job requeuehold decisions. A successful act-mode recovery increments planned and applied; a failure increments planned and error.
panels.title: Failed-job recovery outcomes

panels.description: Environment admission decisions that prevent or question controller ownership of jobs.
panels.title: Routing and admission issues

panels.description: Invalid or action-limited mode decisions. action_denied can be expected during observe-only rollout.
panels.title: Mode policy issues

panels.description: Best-effort log-link operation errors and manifest-scoped cleanup failures. These may not fail the controller tick.
panels.title: Optional log-link issues

panels.description: Resident memory for SAC scrape targets only.
panels.title: Resident memory

panels.description: CPU cores consumed by SAC scrape targets.
panels.title: CPU usage

panels.description: Current Go goroutine count for SAC scrape targets.
panels.title: Goroutines

panels.description: Fraction of the process file descriptor limit currently in use.
panels.title: File descriptor utilization

panels.description: Changes to process start time over the dashboard range, used as a restart indicator.
panels.title: Process restarts

panels.description: Manifest-owned Slurm log links after the most recent completed materializer sync.
panels.title: Owned log links

panels.description: 95th percentile duration of bounded adjacent application-log scans.
panels.title: Log-link scan p95

panels.description: Standalone watchdog poll throughput by mode and outcome.
panels.title: Watchdog polls per minute

panels.description: 95th percentile standalone watchdog poll duration.
panels.title: Watchdog poll duration p95

panels.description: Latest watchdog job counts: observed Slurm jobs, Heimdall-managed jobs, and exact job identities retained in watchdog memory.
panels.title: Watchdog jobs

panels.description: Watchdog release candidates by observe/act mode and planned/applied/error outcome.
panels.title: Watchdog release candidates

list.label: Environment
